description_en: Retrieve a list of deployment jobs
kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio list-deployments --workspace-id 478000 --next-token 10 --max-results 20 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --deployment-id dploy-asdf0000001234 --resource-type Flow --resource-id flow-asdf000000123 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --creator 26800000004103 --resource-snapshot-id snap-asfg000000123 --service-name myservice01 --deployment-status Creating,Running --operation-type Create --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeployments

parameters.help_en: Workspace ID. For information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Pagination cursor used to retrieve the next page of results.  

Leave empty for the first request.  
For subsequent requests, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response.
parameters.help_zh:
分页游标。用于请求下一页检索的结果。
首次请求时置空。
后续请求时传入上一次响应返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of records allowed to be returned in this request.
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求允许返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Field used for sorting in paged queries. The default field is GmtCreateTime. Valid values are as follows:  

GmtCreateTime (default): sort by creation time.  
GmtModifiedTime: sort by updated time.
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的排序字段，默认使用 GmtCreateTime。取值如下。
GmtCreateTime（默认值）：按创建时间。
GmtModifiedTime：按修改时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
Sorting order.  

ASC: ascending.  
DESC: descending.
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。

ASC：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The resource type to be deployed. Valid values:  
Flow: A project of the pipeline pattern  
Code: A project of the Code pattern
parameters.help_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource ID to be deployed.
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Number of items displayed per page. Default value is 10.
parameters.help_zh: 每页所显示的项数，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID of the resource to be deployed. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys directly based on this snapshot. If it is not provided, the system first creates a new snapshot for the resource and then executes the deployment.
parameters.help_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署
